from pathlib import Path
import json,time,sys

campaign=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
model_task="A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4"
cp=campaign/"models/runs"/"A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4-1-165d27d5"
mr=campaign/"model_results"/f"{model_task}.json"

if mr.exists():
    print("E121=R4_RESULT_EXISTS",flush=True); raise SystemExit(0)
if not cp.exists():
    print("E121=RUN_DIR_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(31)

complete=cp/"COMPLETE.json"
events=cp/"events.jsonl"
worker=cp/"WORKER.json"

if complete.exists():
    try:
        c=json.loads(complete.read_text())
        has_final=bool(c.get("final"))
        print("E121=COMPLETE_EXISTS has_final="+str(has_final)+" result_exists=False",flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(10 if has_final else 11)
    except SystemExit:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        print("E121=COMPLETE_INVALID "+type(e).__name__+":"+str(e),flush=True); raise SystemExit(12)

if not worker.exists():
    print("E121=WORKER_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(32)

now=time.time()
event_count=0
last_type=""
event_age=None
last_preview=""
if events.exists():
    lines=[x for x in events.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines() if x.strip()]
    event_count=len(lines)
    if lines:
        try:
            obj=json.loads(lines[-1])
            last_type=str(obj.get("type") or obj.get("item",{}).get("type") or "")
        except Exception:
            last_type="UNPARSED"
        event_age=max(0,int(now-events.stat().st_mtime))
        last_preview=lines[-1][:300].replace("\n"," ")
worker_age=max(0,int(now-worker.stat().st_mtime))
print("E121_PROGRESS events="+str(event_count)+" event_age_s="+str(event_age)+" worker_age_s="+str(worker_age)+" last_type="+repr(last_type)+" last="+repr(last_preview),flush=True)

if events.exists() and event_age is not None:
    if event_age <= 300:
        print("E121=RUN_ACTIVE_RECENT_PROGRESS",flush=True); raise SystemExit(20)
    if event_age <= 900:
        print("E121=RUN_QUIET_NOT_YET_STALE",flush=True); raise SystemExit(21)
    print("E121=RUN_STALE_OVER_15M",flush=True); raise SystemExit(22)

print("E121=NO_EVENTS_YET",flush=True); raise SystemExit(23)
